coverageNote.note: Kroger runs this freight footprint across its store banners, its owned manufacturing division, Home Chef, and the Ocado-automated fulfillment centers, all feeding about 2,700 stores. 62 currently operating sites were mapped from satellite. 15 carry a dated independent verification and are shown; the other 47 are mapped but not yet verified and are held back. Three Ocado facilities closed in the Dec 2025 pullback were removed from the source set entirely.

account.networkCountSource: Kroger FY2024 10-K, Item 2 Properties + Merchandising (as of Feb 3, 2024): 33 food production plants (14 dairies, 9 deli/bakery, 5 grocery, 2 beverage, 1 meat, 2 cheese) plus a supply-chain network Kroger states as more than 30 distribution centers (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000056873/000155837024004603/kr-20240203x10k.htm)
account.sampleRationale: We mapped the largest, newest, and most and least automated banner DCs and Ocado CFCs; the gate-to-dock pattern held across every one.
account.dossierIntro: Kroger is the largest traditional grocer in the US, and its freight moves through three layers: owned manufacturing plants making its own brands, banner distribution centers and Ocado-automated fulfillment centers shipping to stores, and Home Chef production. We mapped 62 currently operating sites from satellite and verified 15 of them against dated independent sources. Those 15 are what you see here. Across them: 3,684 trailer and chassis spots, 1,634 dock doors, 802 acres. 14 of the 15 already run drop yards and 10 sit behind a gate or guard, so the win lands on infrastructure Kroger already built.
surprisingFindings: Mapped and verified are different numbers on purpose. 62 sites are mapped, 15 carry dated independent sourcing, and only those 15 are shown.
Two operating models run side by side: legacy banner DCs and Ocado fulfillment centers. One operating standard spans them, not one per banner.
14 of the 15 verified sites already run drop yards and 10 sit behind a gate or guard, so the win lands on infrastructure Kroger already built.
